title: Complete product alignment
inputs_to_freeze: Freeze the starting project, user-approved reference identity/version and authorized observation access.
Use identical representative short/long answers and attachments, locales and viewport conditions in every arm.

title: Reference access obstruction
inputs_to_freeze: Freeze the same unavailable route and allow the same legitimate alternate documents, recordings and demos.
No login bypass or purchase. User assistance availability must be identical and logged.

title: High-impact small visual asset
inputs_to_freeze: Supply the same brand brief, approved rights boundaries, source assets and header/container context.
Do not tell the agents the evaluator's preferred asset or candidate sources.

title: Temporal state relationships
inputs_to_freeze: Supply identical fixture delays, input actions, selected source states and reduced-motion controls.
Retain actual natural-time playback and records of interruptions, not only endpoint captures.

title: Expressive professional surface
inputs_to_freeze: Freeze the same aesthetic brief, rights-bearing assets and representative task content.
Equal access to functional, cross-domain and implementation references; no preferred library hints.

title: Evidence-sufficient low-impact edit
inputs_to_freeze: Supply a real narrow change, accepted direction, current source and matching-condition evidence.
Same recent inspections for all arms. Judge proportionate convergence as well as correctness.
